purpose: Define the canonical structure of a Memory inside Stashly.
Create durable, searchable, platform-independent knowledge representations that remain useful even when source platforms change.
Serve as the foundation for Semantic Retrieval, Hybrid Retrieval, AI Recall, Memory Chat, Cross-Memory Synthesis, and Future Intelligence Features.
core_principle: A Memory is not the original content. A Memory is a structured representation of knowledge extracted from content. The original content remains the source of truth. The representation becomes the retrieval and intelligence layer.
guiding_principle: The goal is not to build a better bookmark manager. The goal is to build a Memory Operating System. Every future architecture decision should be evaluated against that objective.

layer_1_raw_source.name: Raw Source Layer
layer_1_raw_source.purpose: Preserve the original source information exactly as received.

layer_2_extracted_content.name: Extracted Content Layer
layer_2_extracted_content.purpose: Capture as much information as possible from the source.

layer_3_understanding.name: Understanding Layer
layer_3_understanding.purpose: Convert extracted content into platform-independent knowledge.

layer_4_user.name: User Layer
layer_4_user.purpose: Store knowledge added by the user.

locked: Key insights as a retrieval primitive
Retrieval layer is derived, not authored
